question: Which of the following festivals is associated with Tripura?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kharchi Puja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kharchi Puja:**

 
 
• This festival primarily originates from the State of Tripura.
 
• Earlier it was a festival of the royal family of Tripura, currently, even the common households celebrate this festival.
 
• It is celebrated over a period of **7** days and takes place in the month of July each year.
 
• The festival is celebrated in the honor of Lord Shiva.
 
• Each year thousands of people make the trek to this temple in Agartala so that they can pay obeisance to the deities. 
 
• The temple committee also organizes cultural programs and fairs for the enjoyment of the masses.
